items.name: button
items.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

items.name: avatar
items.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

items.name: badge
items.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: Displays content within a desired ratio.

items.name: alert
items.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

items.name: bubble
items.description: Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

items.name: command
items.description: Command menu for search and quick actions.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: An interactive component which expands and collapses a panel.

items.name: calendar
items.description: A calendar for picking a day, several days or a range, with month and year dropdowns, week numbers and keyboard navigation.

items.name: card
items.description: Displays a card with a header, content and footer.

items.name: carousel
items.description: A carousel with motion and swipe built using native scroll snapping.

items.name: button-group
items.description: A container that groups related buttons into one joined control.

items.name: input-group
items.description: Adds addons, buttons and helper text to an input or a textarea.

items.name: code-block
items.description: Displays code, terminal output and diffs with an optional header, line numbers and a copy button.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A control that toggles between checked and unchecked, or shows a mixed state.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

items.name: drawer
items.description: A drawer component built on Base UI that slides in from the edge of the screen, with swipe to dismiss, snap points and nested stacking.

items.name: table
items.description: A responsive table with header, body, footer and cell parts.

items.name: data-table
items.description: A table with sorting, filtering, pagination and row selection.

items.name: popover
items.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: A button that opens a calendar popover to pick a single day.

items.name: empty
items.description: Displays an empty state with an icon, a title, a description and actions.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

items.name: field
items.description: Combines a label, a control, helper text and a validation message into one accessible form field.

items.name: input
items.description: A single-line text field for forms and user data entry.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: Displays a menu of actions, toggles and choices when a trigger is activated, with groups, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: Displays a menu at the pointer on right click or long press, with groups, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus.

items.name: input-otp
items.description: A row of single-character slots for one-time codes and PIN-like input.

items.name: direction
items.description: A provider component that sets the text direction for your application.

items.name: separator
items.description: A thin line that divides content horizontally or vertically.

items.name: item
items.description: A flex row for media, text and actions, with optional header, footer and grouped lists.

items.name: chat
items.description: A full-height conversation layout: a scrolling message log above a composer.

items.name: checkpoint
items.description: A marker after a point in a conversation, with a restore button you can return to.

items.name: confirmation
items.description: An approval prompt for a tool call, with approve and deny actions and the answer once given.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.description: A collapsible list of reasoning steps, with optional search results and images.

items.name: context
items.description: How much of the context window the conversation has used.

items.name: file-tree
items.description: A nested tree of folders and files that expand and select, for showing the files an agent changed.

items.name: message
items.description: One turn in a conversation, with an avatar, a header, content and a footer.

items.name: attachment
items.description: A file or image chip with a status, actions and an optional trigger that makes the whole card clickable.

items.name: inline-citation
items.description: A source in the sentence that opens on hover.

items.name: model-selector
items.description: Two menus. One picks the model the agent runs, the other picks how hard it thinks.

items.name: plan
items.description: A collapsible card that shows an AI-generated plan, with a header, expandable content and a footer.

items.name: queue
items.description: Displays the agent's todo list, split into what is left and what is done.

items.name: prompt-input
items.description: A message box with a textarea that sends on Enter, header and footer rows, and a submit button that shows the request status.

items.name: sources
items.description: Displays the links the agent used for a reply.

items.name: reasoning
items.description: A collapsible panel that shows a model's thinking: it opens while streaming, closes shortly after, and labels the trigger with the thinking time.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Displays textual keyboard input, such as a key or a shortcut.

items.name: label
items.description: A caption for a form control, linked to it through its id.

items.name: marker
items.description: A compact inline status, note or action row, with an optional icon, border or centered separator label.

items.name: menubar
items.description: A visually persistent horizontal bar of menus with actions, toggles, choices and submenus, common in desktop applications.

items.name: message-scroller
items.description: A chat transcript viewport that follows streamed output, anchors new turns and jumps to messages.

items.name: native-select
items.description: A styled wrapper around the browser's native select element, with option groups and sizes.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: A collection of links for navigating a website, with content that opens in one shared, animated popup.

items.name: pagination
items.description: A row of page links with previous and next controls and an ellipsis for skipped pages.

items.name: progress
items.description: Displays the progress of a task as a bar with an optional label and value.

items.name: questionnaire
items.description: A step-by-step form that asks one question at a time, with choices, free text, progress and navigation.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A set of options where exactly one can be checked.

items.name: resizable
items.description: Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.

items.name: select
items.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from, triggered by a button.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A collapsible side panel with a header, scrollable content, footer and menus.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Displays a pulsing placeholder while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.description: A control that picks a value, or a range of values, by dragging thumbs along a track.

items.name: spinner
items.description: A loading indicator: an icon that spins while work is pending.

items.name: switch
items.description: A control that toggles a setting on and off.

items.name: tabs
items.description: A set of layered sections of content, known as tab panels, that are displayed one at a time.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field for forms and longer user input.

items.name: toast
items.description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

items.name: sonner
items.description: An opinionated toast component.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A two-state button that is either on or off.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: A row or column of toggles that share one pressed state, with one or several items pressed at a time.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

items.name: trace
items.description: The building block for reasoning, tool calls, sources and more.

items.name: typeset
items.description: Typography scale for prose: headings, paragraphs, lists, blockquotes and inline code.

items.name: suggestion
items.description: A horizontal row of pill buttons that offer follow-up prompts, scrolling sideways when they overflow.

items.name: subagent
items.description: A trace line for work handed to a subagent, which expands to show its task, steps, tools and result.

items.name: stack-trace
items.description: Displays an error and its call frames in a collapsible monospace panel, with copy and expand controls.

items.name: task
items.description: A collapsible step of an AI agent's work, with a title trigger, a list of items and file chips.

items.name: terminal
items.description: Displays command output in a monospace panel with copy and clear actions and a streaming indicator, with ANSI escape sequences stripped.

items.name: test-results
items.description: Summarizes a test run with counts, a progress bar and collapsible suites of tests, with error messages and stack traces for failures.

items.name: tool
items.description: Shows one tool call of an AI agent: its name, a status badge and a collapsible panel with the input and the output or error.
